enemy-077-albino-foundry-drone.designLock: PROJECT_ADAPTATION systemic albino derivative of reviewed enemy-025-foundry-drone. Preserve one slender upright XX121-derived biped with a smooth long eyeless dome, compact ribbed torso, exactly four dorsal pipes, two long clawed arms, two digitigrade legs and exactly one long pointed segmented tail. The Albino modifier changes newly authored organic pigment and material response only: warm pearl, pale parchment and cool ash-gray tissue with restrained translucent rose-taupe recesses; practical Foundry exposure remains localized as matte soot, heat-browned tarnish and non-glowing mineral scarring. It is not a white filter and no predecessor pixel may be reused. Strict orthographic gameplay side profile facing RIGHT in idle, move, claw/inner-jaw attack and terminal death. No equipment, riveted armor, furnace, lava, luminous cracks, horns, Warrior ribbed head, Crusher shield, royal crown, copied project pixels, official caste claim, canonExact or 1:1 reproduction claim.

designDetails.silhouette: Slender upright biped with smooth elongated eyeless dome, compact ribbed torso, four dorsal pipes, long clawed arms, digitigrade legs and one complete pointed segmented tail. Read as a Drone, never Crusher, Warrior, Queen or robot.
designDetails.palette: Warm pearl and pale parchment chitin, cool ash-gray recesses and restrained translucent rose-taupe soft tissue. Localized matte soot, brown heat tarnish and non-glowing mineral scars preserve the Foundry history without bleaching all materials or introducing lava.
designDetails.surface: Wet biomechanical ribs, tendons and jaws remain distinct from smoother dome and dry soot/mineral wear. Re-author every micro-detail; no inherited matte edge, magenta residue, lighting or pose.
designDetails.anatomy: One smooth eyeless dome and double jaw, one torso, exactly four dorsal pipes, two arms, two digitigrade legs and exactly one articulated tail. No equipment or additional appendage.
designDetails.equipment: None. Foundry is a surface-history adaptation, not armor, harness, furnace or industrial machinery.
designDetails.orientation: Strict orthographic gameplay side view facing RIGHT in all 32 poses. Dome, limbs, feet, pipes and full tail remain inside each cell with safe gutters.
designDetails.scale: Use the predecessor's skull-to-ribcage, shoulder-to-pelvis and proximal-limb ratios only as qualitative identity guidance. Historical final pack scale 0.505643341 and all-one sourceScaleByClip values are not a measured calibration and are not inherited.

designDetails.background: True transparent RGBA when available, otherwise perfectly uniform pure #FF00FF; no checkerboard, floor, shadow, scenery, text, logo, UI or grid.
